Insights

Four places to read, one for how you like to read

I publish in different places because the work is different. Essays and notes live on this site, research and articles for other publications sit under research, sector pages gather what I know about each field, and the newsletter is where I check claims and add opinion. Pick the route that fits and you'll land on the right page.

Blog

Essays and commentary published on this site: space strategy, science communication, sustainability and digital practice.

For: readers who want the considered, longer view and a piece they can link to and come back to.

Read the blog

Research and writing

Research outputs and articles written for other publications, filterable by topic and by publication.

For: researchers, editors, students and anyone checking what I've published elsewhere.

Research and writing

Sectors

Perspectives organised by field, so you can start from your own area rather than from a format.

For: people in space, Earth observation, climate and sustainability, and deep tech who want the material that applies to them.

Browse the sectors

Signal & Noise newsletter

Space strategy, science communication and fact-checks when evidence loses to noise. New posts every week or two, with shorter Notes in between.

For: readers who want the sourcing, not just the take.

About the newsletterSubscribe on Substack (opens in a new tab)

Not sure where to start?

For a first read, the blog is the best place. If you'd rather have things delivered, subscribe to Signal & Noise. Looking for something specific, such as a topic, a publication or a sector? Try the filters on research and writing, orget in touch and I'll point you to it.
